new malpais.description:

Suspends on simultaneous 6 shots/hits detonations.
Detonations Unravel targets damaged by explosion AND nearby targets.

service of luzaku.description:

Nests that last for 20s can be converted into tangles
Refill on hip-fire healing allies or nests

the manticore.description:

Up to 100% damage while hovering
Partial refund on airborne kill and 15HP Void Overshield

third iteration.description:
Mark on ADS, invis on marked or concentrated crit kill
Extra damage to marked targets
Weaken splash on concentrated crit kill

tommy's matchbook.name: Tommy's Matchbook
tommy's matchbook.description:
720 RPM Rapid-Fire Auto Rifle.
While Hip-firing: Grants massively decreased Accuracy Cone Size and Accuracy Cone Growth.
Holding down the trigger and firing 20 rounds within 0.125 seconds of each activates Ignition Trigger.
Ignition Trigger builds up 20% Heat per second. Constantly drains by -25% per second while not firing.
Ignition Trigger grants +50% increased damage and -3% Accuracy Cone Size while active.
Additionally, it drains -15HP from the user per 0.4 seconds until reaching Critical Health. Drain is reduced to 7.5HP while hip-firing.
Self-damage does not deal damage to Overshields, instead bypassing it.
Catalyst grants unique perk Heat of the Moment: While Ignition Trigger is Active, weapon Final Blows grant Cure x1, and every 5th shot fired applies x10+10 Scorch.

xenophage.name: Xenophage
xenophage.description:
High-Impact Explosive Solar Machine Gun.
Fires Explosive Rounds which deal 75? impact & 75 explosive damage down to 0 at 4.5 meters vs. Guardians.
Catalyst grants Chain Reaction & Rampage perks.
Very bad Heavy choice, as it does not pull much ammo from a crate, and cannot 1HKO at neutral.

cull's shadow.name: Cull's Shadow
cull's shadow.description:
Hybrid Aggressive Fusion Rifle / Glaive.
Fires a 4 bolt horizontal spread like Aggressive Fusion Rifles, and struggles to 1HKO anyone.
Glaive functionality is basically equivalent to any Glaive's melee.
Scoring 2 rapid hits with Frontal Blades or Scoring a Final Blow grants a stack of Soulfire Charge & heals +40 HP.
Soulfire Charge can be consumed by firing Fusion Rifle bolts, inflicting Potent Corruption poison, dealing ? Damage-over-Time on hit.
Enemies who die under the effect of Potent Corruption are turned into Soulfire Crystals, which can be destroyed to trigger a ? Kinetic Damage detonation over 8 meters.
Soulfire crystals spawn & explode based on varying activation conditions, but can be detonated by dealing damage to them, or expiring after 15 seconds.
This weapon is not good. It also does NOT count as a Glaive Melee for purposes of damage increases. Do not use it in PvP.

fafnir.name: Fafnir
fafnir.description:
Precision Linear Fusion Rifle.
Long range Tractor Cannon option.
Converts ammo into an "Overpressurized" shot, which applies a 30% weaken to hit enemies.
As it stands, it isn't worth using this as it eats ammo and doesn't really gain much from doing so. A standard Precision Linear will 1-shot headshot anyone to begin with, even in Supers. The only use case for this is to overpressurize the shot and then body shot 1 target with it.

praxic blade.name: Praxic Blade
praxic blade.description:
Special Ammo Sword with varying Traits & Perks based on customizable pieces.
Loses all Ammo on Death & Respawn. Gains reduced (50% less) ammo gains from all Special Ammo sources, such as a Wall boxes and kills. Ammo bricks picked up grant 1 ammo each.
Light Attacks performs a melee combo with each attack dealing 256 damage vs. Guardians. Using a Heavy Attack after performing 3 Light Attacks performs a Cormarant Combo, dealing 368 damage vs. Guardians, followed by 3 hits of 220 damage vs. Guardians each.
Heavy Attack performs a ranged blade throw, homing in on up to 3 enemies within 50 meters, dealing up to 174 damage vs. Guardians. Damage reduced by 80% on return after 3 hits or target loss. Attacking recall the blade immediately.
Heavy Attacks performed while HOLDING Heavy Attack throw the blade in a Straight Line with no tracking and deals 100% increased damage (348 damage vs. Guardians). Releasing Hold immediately recalls the blade.
Blocking provides ~46% DR in a frontal cone and reflects all impacting projectiles back towards targets near your reticle, dealing 50 damage vs. Guardians.
Airborne light attacks deal ~20%? REDUCED damage, preventing 1HKO neutral.
In lieu of detailing everything this does with various customizable pieces, I instead encourage you to look at Destiny Data Compendium for details.
I recommend using Defensive Form, Refraction Core, and Hyperblade for PvP generally. 
Defensive Form grants the following traits: Blocking an attack within 1 second of beginning Guard grants +20% increased damage for 2 seconds. Blocking multiple attacks within ? seconds grants +1 ammo from thin air, with a 1 second cooldown. 
Refraction Core grants the following trait: On Reflect Bolt hit grants Super-Subclass matching effect. Arc = Grants x1 Bolt Charge, Solar = Inflicts x10+7? Scorch to Target, Void = Inflicts Weaken on Target for ? seconds, Stasis = Inflicts x20 Slow on Target for ? seconds, and Strand = Inflicts Sever for ? seconds.  
Hyperblade Catalyst: Reflecting attacks via Guard grants Amplified for 15 seconds, and grants +100% increased Lunge Distance for the next melee swing. Hyperblade is removed on Stow.
Significantly worse than Ergo Sum options for PvP, but can still be useful for being a 3rd-person Peek tool and 1 hit option.

wolfsbane.name: Wolfsbane
wolfsbane.description:
Solar Heavy Axe.
Uses the same animation & moveset as Twilight Arsenal's Axes.
Light Attacks deal 377 damage vs. Guardians and spawn 3 Quicksilver Nanites every 3 hits, or on Final Blows.
Heavy Attacks while having at least 10% Sword Energy, consume 3 ammo to generate a Solar Wave similar to Burning Maul, which travel 10 meters forward and deals 301 damage vs. Guardians impacted.
Airborne Heavy attacks ALWAYS consume 2 ammo and generate Solar Wave, regardless of Sword Energy.
Wolfsbane deals up to 25% increased damage to targets affected by Outbreak Perfected's Nanites.
Quicksilver Nanites attach to user and restore +5? HP on pickup, granting progress towards Nano-Assault & Overclock. Progress resets on Death.
Overclock can be activated once progress has reached full. Activate via Special Reload. Once activated, gain +14 Ammo from thin air, +25% damage, and rapidly gain +30% Sword Energy per second.
While Overclocked, Heavy Attacks always generate Solar Wave. Fully Charged Heavy Attacks generate a Quicksilver Nanite Tornado, dealing 376 damage vs. Guardians, and 55 damage vs Guardians every 0.3 seconds over 5 meters for 3 seconds.
Grants varying amounts of Damage Resistance for 5 seconds upon scoring ? Light Attacks within 3? seconds of each other.
Damage Resistance amount and Hit Requirement change depending on equipped Handle.
Unyielding = 15% DR after 2 hits, Rampager's = 20% DR after 3 hits, and Tenacious = 25% DR after 4 hits.
Has selectable Catalyst which grants various perks. Options are: Burning Ambition, Attrition Orbs, Relentless Strikes, or SUBROUTINE: ~RECURSION.
Recursion: Nanites restore additional HP on pickup based current stacks of Nano-Assault. Spawns additional Nanites while YOU take damage while Nano-Assault is active, with a 2s cooldown.
Generally not a very good Sword option. Caster/Wave Frames can cover the ranged attacks distances easier, and Eager Edge Swords are generally more ammo efficient & useful. Do not use this.

buried bloodline.name: Buried Bloodline
buried bloodline.description:
Micro-Missile-esque Special Ammo Sidearm.
Fires two Tracking Void Bolts which deal 42.3 (50.76 Precision) damage each.
Each bolt heals 11 HP on hit, for a total of 22 HP possible per shot.
Kills progress a counter towards triggering Devour. Guardians grant 25% per kill. Kills while Devour is active do not grant progress.
Catalyst grants unique perk Splitvein Lineage: While Devour is active, hits Weaken targets for 3? seconds and Grants increased +? Reload and +0.x? Reload Duration.
Has generally the same issues as all the Micro-missile Sidearms in PvP. Does not deal enough damage or consistently hit targets enough, despite additional tracking.

salvation's grip.name: Salvation's Grip
salvation's grip.description:
Chargeable Stasis Crystal Launcher.
Charged shots fire Stasis crystal projectiles in V shaped pattern.
Uncharged shots behave as impact grenades, and will always detonate impacted Stasis Crystals.
Not very useful as an actual damage dealing weapon, but can be useful as an area denial tool.
Crystals can block hallways, resses, capture points, or sight lines and are durable against enemy damage.
Overall, not particularly useful as there are simply easier, more consistent ways to generate Stasis Crystals if needed that aren't dependent on Heavy ammo.

the fourth horseman.name: The Fourth Horseman
the fourth horseman.description:
Rapid-Fire Arc Pellet Shotgun.
Fires 12 pellets with a 1.1x Precision Multiplier.
Each successive shot within 0.5 seconds has increased damage and pellet spread.
2nd: +17.7% damage and +25% pellet spread.
3rd: +36.5% damage and +33% pellet spread
4th: +56.5% damage and +33% pellet spread
5th: +77.5% damage and +33% pellet spread
Kills refill ammo from reserve.
Catalyst grants unique perk And Its Name Was Death: Passively grants +40 Reload and +1 Magazine size.
This shotgun is absolutely atrocious. Struggles to 1HKO, and follow up shots having increased pellet spread makes it harder to clean up targets even with rapid shots.

ex diris.name: Ex Diris
ex diris.description:
Arc Hive Boomer Grenade Launcher
Weapon does not require reloading ever.
Shoots Arcing Arc projectiles which deal 21 impact damage and up to 119 explosive damage vs. Guardians, down to 35.3 damage at 4.5meters.
Builds up 25% Enrage per hit, gradually granting up to 0.6x Firing Recovery Delay (effectively 40% RPM increase)
Reaching Critical Health immediately grants maximum Enrage. Charge decays over 9.5 seconds.
Upon Final Blow or scoring 2 Direct Hits rapidly, spawns a Loyal Arc Moth which seeks the closest enemy within 60?m, and deals 31 Explosive Arc damage over 7meters, and inflicts Arc Blind,
Moths do not deal self-damage to user. Incurs a 3 second cooldown between Moth spawns.
Catalyst grants unique perk Berserk Rush: Grants Amplified on Kill. Hits while Amplified grant 50% Enrage progress on hit.
While using the Hunter Exotic Mothkeeper's Wraps: Loyal Arc Moth spawns additionally spawn a Loyal Void Moth, which seeks out the nearest Ally and grant them 22.5 Void Overshield on contact.
Weapon is best used as a clean-up tool, and struggles to kill targets even in 2 shots unless you direct impact with both.

heartshadow.name: Heartshadow
heartshadow.description:
Short Range Projectile Sword.
Heavy Attacks while Sword Energy is full fires a fan of up to 4 short range, fast moving Void explosives which deal 363 damage vs. Guardians, and turn the user Invisible for 6.3 seconds.
After being invisible for 0.25s (from any source), gain Shot in the Dark. Shot in the Dark grants 25% increased damage, and hits Weaken enemies for 3 seconds. Kills grant Invisibility for 6.3 seconds.
Catalyst grants unique perk Wraithwalk: Increases reserves by 6, and grants +50% Movement Speed while Shot in the Dark is active.
Generally not a very useful Heavy sword option, especially compared to Eager Edge choices. There are easier ways to achieve Invisibility, and swords that are much faster moving, deadlier, and more ammo efficient.

verglas curve.name: Verglas Curve
verglas curve.description:
Lightweight Combat Bow.
Final Blows grant 1 stack of Hail Barrage, up to a max of 5 stacks. Stacks persist through stow.
Hipfiring will release all Hail Barrage stacks simultaneously in an evenly spaced volley.
Hail Barrage arrows spawn a Large Stasis Crystal on hit/impact, inflicting x60 Slow for 1+1 seconds on Direct Hit.
Deals 50% increased damage to Frozen Enemies & Stasis Crystals.
Catalyst grants Unique Trait Shiver Quiver: Upon inflicting Slow or Freeze, gain 0.65x Draw Time for Verglas Curve for 5 seconds.
Generally just not a good bow. There are easier, more consistent ways to freeze, slow, or shatter targets.

deterministic chaos.name: Deterministic Chaos
deterministic chaos.description:
Very, very bad LMG. Does nothing good and is significantly worse than almost every other LMG in the game despite being an exotic.
Volatile every 4th shot.
Weaken every 16th shot (32nd shot? Seems bugged??)
Catalyst grants Target Lock.

devil's ruin.name: Devil's Ruin
devil's ruin.description:
Adaptive Sidearm.
Hits against Suspended targets inflict x20+10 Scorch.
Final Blows spawn Firesprite. Picking up a Firesprite grants Pyrogenesis Available. Hold special Reload to convert Pyrogenesis Available to Pyrogenesis Ready. Both Pyrogenesis states persists through Stow.
While Pyrogenesis Ready: Firing this weapon instead charges over 0.5seconds then discharges a continuous Solar Beam over 0.95seconds, which deals 22 damage per hit (35.2 Precision) and deals x20+10 Scorch per hit up to 16 times at 900 RPM. Kills with this Laser cause an immediate Ignition at target location. Magazine is refilled upon complete discharge of Pyrogenesis laser.
Catalyst grants this weapon the Collective Action perk.
Weapon can be used to easily convert a single kill into 2.

edge of intent.name: Edge of Intent
edge of intent.description:
Aggressive Glaive.
After scoring 6 hits, either by Glaive Melee or Glaive projectile hits: Enables Special Reload. Glaive Projectiles count as 2 hits.
Special Reload converts the next shot into a placeable Healing turret, refilling & overfilling the magazine by +1, and granting +1 ammo.
Healing Turret lasts 9 seconds and releases a Healing Seeker to the user and nearby allies within 30 meters every 3 seconds if they are not at full HP. Each turret can release up to 3 Seekers over its lifetime.
Healing Seekers grants Cure x1 & Restoration x1 for 3 (+1.5 w/ Ember of Solace) seconds in a 7.5m radius.
Touch of Flame grants the USER ONLY x2 Cure & x2 Restoration.
Catalyst grants Heal Clip perk.

ruinous effigy.name: Ruinous Effigy
ruinous effigy.description:
"COME ON AND SLAM!"
Converts enemies into Transmutation Spheres on Final Blow.
Transmutation Spheres have 30 ammo, and can persist on the ground for 30 seconds.
User can pickup the Spheres, which have a Light Attack, Heavy Attack, and Guard actions.
Light Attack does a small lunge and deals 150 damage vs. Guardians (187.5 while airborne), and consumes 1 ammo per swing. 
Heavy Attack performs a ~5meter area AoE slam, immediately consuming the Sphere and dealing 300 damage & suppressing to all enemies within the radius with NO FALLOFF. 
Guarding generates a Life Drain field in a sphere shaped area around the user, granting 50% Damage Resist, Immunity to Knockback effects, and dealing 12 damage every 0.3 seconds to enemies within the field. Each damage instance to enemies transfers 5/HP to user as well. Ammo is drained at a rate of 1 per every 0.25s. Drains slower when at 3 or lower ammo, at a rate of 1/0.50s. At 1 Ammo, instead triggers TRANSFIGURATION, dealing increasing self damage every 0.7s, until Guard cancel or User Death. Transfiguration ignores all forms of Damage Resist.
Catalyst grants Unique Trait Deconstruction: Transmutation Orb kills grant a flat +15% damage buff for 7 seconds.
This weapon is actually surprisingly dangerous to play against. In Trials, a good player can convert a single Trace Rifle kill into a sphere and easily collapse it onto a 2nd or even 3rd player very rapidly ending the round. Pairs especially well with Cyrtarache's Facade & Grapple, or Blink movement builds.

symmetry.name: Symmetry
symmetry.description:
Arc Rapid-Fire Scout Rifle.
Hold Special Reload to swap to Tracking Arc Seekers mode.
Arc Seekers deal 50 damage per hit to Guardians, in a small AoE splash of ~3m.
Precision Hits & Final Blows grant Dynamic Charge stacks. 
Special Reload refills the magazine equivalent to the number of Dynamic Charge stacks & overcharges Arc Seekers by an escalating amount of +% damage based on the number of Dynamic Charge stacks.
At x3 DC Stacks, becomes 3HKO vs. Guardians, at x7+, becomes 2HKO vs. Guardians.
Hits with Arc Seekers grant +2 Bolt Charge stacks, while at 10 or higher Dynamic Charge stacks, grants +3 Bolt Charge stacks instead.
Arc Seeker damage can discharge Bolt Charge so long as you have at least x1 Dynamic Charge when damage is dealt. Storm's Keep will discharge TWO INSTANCES of Bolt Charge in this scenario.
Catalyst allows Dynamic Charge to stack up to 20x and grants the Eddy Current trait.

the prospector.name: The Prospector
the prospector.description:
Fires Exploding Submunition grenades.
Unlike most Rapid-Fire Heavy GLs, can reliably 1-shot on direct impact due to extra damage dealt by submunitions after target hit so long as the target is actually hit by the submunitions.
Airborne targets are unlikely to get hit, as the submunitions spawn from point of impact and then drop downwards.

vigilance wing.name: Vigilance Wing
vigilance wing.description:
5-Round burst Pulse Rifle. 0.83 base TTK, at 8c2b.
On Ally Death within 24meters: Gain +20 Mobility, increases Sprint Speed to by +0.5m/s (up to 9m/s cap), increases slide distance by +2.0m (Base 6.5->8.5m) for 6 seconds. Immediately triggers Health regeneration.
While Last Guardian Standing or Solo: Grants +100 Health Stat, +?(Significant) Handling, and +30? Reload Speed.
Generally just worse than just about any other standard pulse rifle due to the increased bullet count per burst. Bonuses have reliable uptime in 6s, but due to their triggers being tied nearby & ally deaths, can be somewhat inconsistent for being active when you actually need/want them.

worldline zero.name: Worldline Zero
worldline zero.description:
Basically an easy-mode, less ammo efficient Eager Edge sword.
While at full Sword Energy, enables Tesseract Blink Heavy attack after sprinting briefly. Can be used mid-air.
Tesseract Blink Heavy attack functions similar to a Vortex Frame heavy attack, lunging forward a great distance while spinning and dealing damage in a circle around your character, costs 3 ammo to use.
Scoring a Final Blow with Tesseract Blink attack automatically re-activates Tesseract Blink to be used. Can be used even without full Sword Energy during this time, reducing ammo cost of the heavy attack to 1 instead of 3.
Generally recommend using any Eager Edge sword over this.

still hunt.name: Still Hunt
still hunt.description:
Special Reload while charged to gain 3 Golden Gun shots. Charge granted on 6 crits (2 Points progress per Crit) or by collecting 12 orbs (1 point progress per Orb collected), or by any mixture of Crits/Orbs which = 12 points. Progress persists through death.
Spawns 3 ammo from thin air on Golden Gun cast.
Intrinsically has increased Aim Assist, Faster ADS speed, and Bonus Flinch Resistance. These bonuses are increased when Cayde's Retribution is active. Additionally, Cayde's Retribution also grants 18% increased Aim Assist fall off distance, and -60%? Accuracy Cone buffs.
Golden Gun shots deal 238 base damage with a 2x Precision Multiplier. Successive hits with Golden Gun shots increase subsequent damage, x2 = 45%, x3 = 90%.

revision zero.name: Revision Zero
revision zero.description:
Dealing Precision damage grants Targeting Data progress, up to 4 stacks. Special Reload will convert current Targeting Data into equivalent number of Hunter's Trace rounds. Replaces weapon's base 18 zoom with a 50 zoom Sniper Scope that fires WITH PERFECT ACCURACY & produces Sniper Glint on enemy screen.
Hunter's Trace shots deal massively increased damage, release a small Exhausting Kinetic Shockwave on hit, and overpenetrates targets AND Barricades.
Shots deal 158 base body shot damage, 513.5 Precision damage, and 20 damage from Kinetic Shockwave, Kinetic Shockwave Exhausts targets for 5s, reducing their outgoing damage by 10%.
Can "Grind Stacks" like Hawkmoon or No Time via dealing damage even without landing a Final Blow. Once charged, can be used to break a stalemate or get a pick. Hunter's Trace rounds persist through Stow and are only cleared by firing all loaded rounds or dying.

lumina.name: Lumina
lumina.description:
Final Blows create Remnant at target location, with catalyst this is increased to 2 Remnants. Collect Remnants to receive Noble Rounds equal to number of Remnants gathered.
Noble Rounds hip-fired at Allies immediately heal target for 90HP and grant user & Allied Target +15% Damage buff & +100 Class stat for 11 seconds. Damage buff stacks with other Damage buffs multiplicatively, and is enough to shift TTK on a large variety of weapons on its own. Class stat bonus will activate >100 Overshield effect as well if user has enough Class (1 at least Lol) to reach over 100. 
Boots of the Assembler's Noble Seekers grant user 1 Noble Round per seeker.

sunshot.name: Sunshot
sunshot.description:
150 RPM Hand Cannon, 0.80 TTK.
Intrinsic Explosive Payload.
Scorching explosions on kill, functionally a 2x stronger Firefly w/ a weaker variant of Incandescent DoT attached, which deals 10+5 Scorch creating a brief healing delay.

polaris lance.name: Polaris Lance
polaris lance.description:
Gains Scorching Explosive round on four precision hits. 
Scorch round deals 78 damage in a small radius and applies x40+20 Scorch to targets hit by AoE.
Dragonfly & Zen Moment. 
Energy slot alternative to The Jade Rabbit, with a DoT that can create opportunities to push up on weakened enemies.

red death reformed.name: Red Death Reformed
red death reformed.description:
Uses Auto Rifle recoil pattern and has naturally low Recoil Bounce Intensity.
Improved Heal Clip with +100 Reload & 0.8x Reload Duration boost and Cure x2 on kill, and Cure x1 to Allies within 15?m
Deals up to 6% increased damage as your shield is damaged. Starting at 2%, up to 6% at 0 Shield (Critical Health).
Spawns ToF Healing grenade on every 2nd Final Blow. Incredible for keeping your team healthy.

tarrabah.name: Tarrabah
tarrabah.description:
Base 16 Zoom and low recoil intensity. Ravenous Beast grants significant fire rate increase.
50% Solar resist while Ravenous Beast is active. 
Can "Grind Stacks" similar to Hawkmoon or No Time, simply deal damage and even without securing final blows you will eventually be able to activate Ravenous Beast to break a stalemate or get a pick.

ergo sum.name: Ergo Sum
ergo sum.description:
Special ammo sword with different exotic traits. Spawns with ZERO ammo every life or start of each round in Trials. Receives 50% Ammo progress from Wall Ammo boxes.
Specifically powerful in PvP with the Wave Frame-Arc Conductor variant. 
Increased damage and grenade regen while Transcendent
Regens ammo on Prismatic grenade damage.

turncoat.name: Turncoat
turncoat.description:
Semi-Explosive Payload Void Adaptive 140 Handcannon.
Charges Unleashed Power via Dealing Damage/Final Blows. Can "Grind Stacks" similar to Hawkmoon or No Time by dealing damage even without securing final blows, then once charged can be used to break stalemates or get a pick.
While fully charged Hold Reload to activate Unleashed Power, converting to 225 RPM Last Word frame w/ extreme unlimited ammo, inflicts weaken on hit, damage buffs & explosive payload.

legend of acrius.name: Legend of Acrius
legend of acrius.description:
Fires Shock Blast shells which deal EXTREMELY high damage, overpenetrates targets, and have MASSIVELY increased Range compared to other shotguns.
Gains Trench Barrel via Catalyst.

cloudstrike.name: Cloudstrike
cloudstrike.description:
Lightning storm and Bolt Charge x5 on Precision kill or 3 Rapid Precision Hits
Catalyst grants +25 Handling and Triple Tap

conditional finality.name: Conditional Finality
conditional finality.description:
"Pride Eternal's American Nightmare."
Fires in Stasis Triangle & Solar Circle Patterns.
Freeze or Ignite on 10 pellets hit.
Anti-Cheese/DR & AoE shotgun.
Catalyst provides Rimestealer & Heal Clip perks.
Will kill through Weavewalk, Antaeus, Overshields, etc. & is very strong vs. supers.

outbreak perfected.name: Outbreak Perfected
outbreak perfected.description:
Uses unique low-recoil/bounce intensity Auto Rifle Recoil pattern.
Tracking Nanites spawn on precision hits, and Nanite Swarms spawn on Precision Kills.
Nanites deal 13 per hit, and increase damage taken by further nanites for a short duration.
Prevents enemy res for a brief time via Swarm Clouds.

duality.name: Duality
duality.description:
Dual pellet/slug modes. Fires pellet spread while hip-firing, or fires Slugs while ADS.
Instrinsically has 5% increased range/fall off distance vs. Legendary shotguns.
On Black Wings stacking damage perk.
Catalyst grants: +20 Range & increases magainze size to 8 Baseline.

final warning.name: Final Warning
final warning.description:
While Hip-firing: Fires Unraveling tracking projectile burst on Charge-Shot that deals 20% increased Body shot damage.
While ADS: Fires Hitscan projectiles with 100% crit damage bonus.
Very devestating to play against in good hands.
Charge Time shot is not good against teams who will teamshot you before the charge completes, or void hunters who dodge with Vanishing Step to break Tracking.

graviton spike grenades.name: Graviton Spike Grenades
graviton spike grenades.description:
150 RPM Handcannon, 0.80 TTK.
3 crits or kills overcharge 3 shots of alternate mode. 
Like Hawkmoon or No Time, can "Grind Stacks" to convert to empowered shots to break stalemates or get a pick. Not as effective though as the extra damage isn't as substantial to guarantee a kill, but Stasis Slow and Lightning AoE can punish overextending opponents.
Stasis spawns crystals, Arc has lightning
Temporal Alignment: 20% damage on both overcharges

rat king.name: Rat King
rat king.description:
"Free Kit & a Level 1 Stitcher."
Rat Pack increases fire rate and mag size on reload.
Invisibility and Health regen on kill reload.

winterbite.name: Winterbite
winterbite.description:
Can be used as a standard Glaive even without ammo, granting access to a Close Range combat option at all times.
Fires medium speed Freezing explosive projectiles.
50% melee damage boost while loaded with Ammo, enables 2 hit melee kill.

ace of spades.name: Ace of Spades
ace of spades.description:
"I'm coming home, Ace."
Adaptive 140 Hand Cannon
+27% damage via Memento Mori for 6 shots
Built-in unique, stronger Firefly & Always Active Radar.
Firefly does more damage while Memento Mori is active.

fighting lion.name: Fighting Lion
fighting lion.description:
Gains +70 reload for 7s on damage dealt
Deals +24.5% damage to shields, Volatile on hit
Kills near Fighting Lion damage refill mag

hawkmoon.name: Hawkmoon
hawkmoon.description:
"Lord, I can't change..."
Escalating damage bonus up to 508% damage on final shot of a Magazine, based on stacks of Paracausal Charges gained, up to 7 stacks.
Very strong vs. Supers, DR, etc. Can also "Grind Stacks" via precision hits even without landing Final Blows, then convert to a 1-tap with high stacks to break stalemates or get a pick.
Catalyst increases mag size by 1, and grants Hunter's Trance perk.
Hunter's Trance grants escalating Range, Reload, and Handling per stack of Paracausal Shot.
Grants +8 / +14 / +22 / +26 / +28 / +29 / +30 Range.
+15 / +25 / +35 / +40 / +50 / +50(?) / Reload
+? / +? / +? / +? / +? Handling

no time to explain.name: No Time to Explain
no time to explain.description:
"I don't even have time to explain why I don't have time to explain."
Time-slip Portal fires additional bursts of Pulse Rifle fire automatically at targets. Typically deals body shot damage, but CAN hit precision hits in rare cases. 
Like Hawkmoon and Tarrabah, you can "Grind Stacks" without securing any kills simply by landing precisions even if you do not land Final Blows. This makes this weapon exceptionally powerful to break stalemates.
Enables easier, more consietent two-burst kills when active.

the chaperone.name: The Chaperone
the chaperone.description:
"Model 1887."
Yeehaw Shotgun.
Extra large sized headshot accuracy & AA cone, with 5% extended range vs. other slug shotguns.
Snags headshot in different area codes.
The Roadborn provides precision damage & handling buff

the jade rabbit.name: The Jade Rabbit
the jade rabbit.description:
Oppressive Scout rifle that very easily hits optimal 0.80 TTK, and has built-in Firefly & Shoot to Loot.
Loads Micro-Missile Rocket when special reload is performed w/ Stacks of Fate of All Fools active.
Buffs body damage on precision hits

the last word.name: The Last Word

225 RPM, 0.53 TTK.

thorn.name: Thorn
thorn.description:
"Every Rose has its..."
Inflicts Poison on hit, inflicting extra damage and preventing health regen.
Spawns Remnant on kill at target location. Collecting Remnants loads/overflows 4 rounds into the magazine, up to 40 total, and grants Soul Devourer & Refined Soul (with Catalyst) for 7 seconds, and can be refreshed up to a maximum of 11 seconds by picking up additional Remnants. Additionally, Refined Soul will trigger on Kill.
Soul Devourer increases Poison damage from 0.4 to 1.6 damage per tick, and Refined Soul grants +10 Range, +15 Handling, and +50 Mobility. Both Soul Devourer & Refined Soul persist through stow.

tommy's matchbook.name: Tommy's Matchbook
tommy's matchbook.description:
720 RPM Rapid-Fire Auto Rifle.
While Hip-firing: Grants massively decreased Accuracy Cone Size and Accuracy Cone Growth.
Holding down the trigger and firing 20 rounds within 0.125 seconds of each activates Ignition Trigger.
Ignition Trigger builds up 20% Heat per second. Constantly drains by -25% per second while not firing.
Ignition Trigger grants +50% increased damage and -3% Accuracy Cone Size while active.
Additionally, it drains -15HP from the user per 0.4 seconds until reaching Critical Health. Drain is reduced to 7.5HP while hip-firing.
Self-damage does not deal damage to Overshields, instead bypassing it.
Catalyst grants unique perk Heat of the Moment: While Ignition Trigger is Active, weapon Final Blows grant Cure x1, and every 5th shot fired applies x10+10 Scorch.

xenophage.name: Xenophage
xenophage.description:
High-Impact Explosive Solar Machine Gun.
Fires Explosive Rounds which deal 75? impact & 75 explosive damage down to 0 at 4.5 meters vs. Guardians.
Catalyst grants Chain Reaction & Rampage perks.
Very bad Heavy choice, as it does not pull much ammo from a crate, and cannot 1HKO at neutral.

cull's shadow.name: Cull's Shadow
cull's shadow.description:
Hybrid Aggressive Fusion Rifle / Glaive.
Fires a 4 bolt horizontal spread like Aggressive Fusion Rifles, and struggles to 1HKO anyone.
Glaive functionality is basically equivalent to any Glaive's melee.
Scoring 2 rapid hits with Frontal Blades or Scoring a Final Blow grants a stack of Soulfire Charge & heals +40 HP.
Soulfire Charge can be consumed by firing Fusion Rifle bolts, inflicting Potent Corruption poison, dealing ? Damage-over-Time on hit.
Enemies who die under the effect of Potent Corruption are turned into Soulfire Crystals, which can be destroyed to trigger a ? Kinetic Damage detonation over 8 meters.
Soulfire crystals spawn & explode based on varying activation conditions, but can be detonated by dealing damage to them, or expiring after 15 seconds.
This weapon is not good. It also does NOT count as a Glaive Melee for purposes of damage increases. Do not use it in PvP.

fafnir.name: Fafnir
fafnir.description:
Precision Linear Fusion Rifle.
Long range Tractor Cannon option.
Converts ammo into an "Overpressurized" shot, which applies a 30% weaken to hit enemies.
As it stands, it isn't worth using this as it eats ammo and doesn't really gain much from doing so. A standard Precision Linear will 1-shot headshot anyone to begin with, even in Supers. The only use case for this is to overpressurize the shot and then body shot 1 target with it.

praxic blade.name: Praxic Blade
praxic blade.description:
Special Ammo Sword with varying Traits & Perks based on customizable pieces.
Loses all Ammo on Death & Respawn. Gains reduced (50% less) ammo gains from all Special Ammo sources, such as a Wall boxes and kills. Ammo bricks picked up grant 1 ammo each.
Light Attacks performs a melee combo with each attack dealing 256 damage vs. Guardians. Using a Heavy Attack after performing 3 Light Attacks performs a Cormarant Combo, dealing 368 damage vs. Guardians, followed by 3 hits of 220 damage vs. Guardians each.
Heavy Attack performs a ranged blade throw, homing in on up to 3 enemies within 50 meters, dealing up to 174 damage vs. Guardians. Damage reduced by 80% on return after 3 hits or target loss. Attacking recall the blade immediately.
Heavy Attacks performed while HOLDING Heavy Attack throw the blade in a Straight Line with no tracking and deals 100% increased damage (348 damage vs. Guardians). Releasing Hold immediately recalls the blade.
Blocking provides ~46% DR in a frontal cone and reflects all impacting projectiles back towards targets near your reticle, dealing 50 damage vs. Guardians.
Airborne light attacks deal ~20%? REDUCED damage, preventing 1HKO neutral.
In lieu of detailing everything this does with various customizable pieces, I instead encourage you to look at Destiny Data Compendium for details.
I recommend using Defensive Form, Refraction Core, and Hyperblade for PvP generally. 
Defensive Form grants the following traits: Blocking an attack within 1 second of beginning Guard grants +20% increased damage for 2 seconds. Blocking multiple attacks within ? seconds grants +1 ammo from thin air, with a 1 second cooldown. 
Refraction Core grants the following trait: On Reflect Bolt hit grants Super-Subclass matching effect. Arc = Grants x1 Bolt Charge, Solar = Inflicts x10+7? Scorch to Target, Void = Inflicts Weaken on Target for ? seconds, Stasis = Inflicts x20 Slow on Target for ? seconds, and Strand = Inflicts Sever for ? seconds.  
Hyperblade Catalyst: Reflecting attacks via Guard grants Amplified for 15 seconds, and grants +100% increased Lunge Distance for the next melee swing. Hyperblade is removed on Stow.
Significantly worse than Ergo Sum options for PvP, but can still be useful for being a 3rd-person Peek tool and 1 hit option.

wolfsbane.name: Wolfsbane
wolfsbane.description:
Solar Heavy Axe.
Uses the same animation & moveset as Twilight Arsenal's Axes.
Light Attacks deal 377 damage vs. Guardians and spawn 3 Quicksilver Nanites every 3 hits, or on Final Blows.
Heavy Attacks while having at least 10% Sword Energy, consume 3 ammo to generate a Solar Wave similar to Burning Maul, which travel 10 meters forward and deals 301 damage vs. Guardians impacted.
Airborne Heavy attacks ALWAYS consume 2 ammo and generate Solar Wave, regardless of Sword Energy.
Wolfsbane deals up to 25% increased damage to targets affected by Outbreak Perfected's Nanites.
Quicksilver Nanites attach to user and restore +5? HP on pickup, granting progress towards Nano-Assault & Overclock. Progress resets on Death.
Overclock can be activated once progress has reached full. Activate via Special Reload. Once activated, gain +14 Ammo from thin air, +25% damage, and rapidly gain +30% Sword Energy per second.
While Overclocked, Heavy Attacks always generate Solar Wave. Fully Charged Heavy Attacks generate a Quicksilver Nanite Tornado, dealing 376 damage vs. Guardians, and 55 damage vs Guardians every 0.3 seconds over 5 meters for 3 seconds.
Grants varying amounts of Damage Resistance for 5 seconds upon scoring ? Light Attacks within 3? seconds of each other.
Damage Resistance amount and Hit Requirement change depending on equipped Handle.
Unyielding = 15% DR after 2 hits, Rampager's = 20% DR after 3 hits, and Tenacious = 25% DR after 4 hits.
Has selectable Catalyst which grants various perks. Options are: Burning Ambition, Attrition Orbs, Relentless Strikes, or SUBROUTINE: ~RECURSION.
Recursion: Nanites restore additional HP on pickup based current stacks of Nano-Assault. Spawns additional Nanites while YOU take damage while Nano-Assault is active, with a 2s cooldown.
Generally not a very good Sword option. Caster/Wave Frames can cover the ranged attacks distances easier, and Eager Edge Swords are generally more ammo efficient & useful. Do not use this.

buried bloodline.name: Buried Bloodline
buried bloodline.description:
Micro-Missile-esque Special Ammo Sidearm.
Fires two Tracking Void Bolts which deal 42.3 (50.76 Precision) damage each.
Each bolt heals 11 HP on hit, for a total of 22 HP possible per shot.
Kills progress a counter towards triggering Devour. Guardians grant 25% per kill. Kills while Devour is active do not grant progress.
Catalyst grants unique perk Splitvein Lineage: While Devour is active, hits Weaken targets for 3? seconds and Grants increased +? Reload and +0.x? Reload Duration.
Has generally the same issues as all the Micro-missile Sidearms in PvP. Does not deal enough damage or consistently hit targets enough, despite additional tracking.

salvation's grip.name: Salvation's Grip
salvation's grip.description:
Chargeable Stasis Crystal Launcher.
Charged shots fire Stasis crystal projectiles in V shaped pattern.
Uncharged shots behave as impact grenades, and will always detonate impacted Stasis Crystals.
Not very useful as an actual damage dealing weapon, but can be useful as an area denial tool.
Crystals can block hallways, resses, capture points, or sight lines and are durable against enemy damage.
Overall, not particularly useful as there are simply easier, more consistent ways to generate Stasis Crystals if needed that aren't dependent on Heavy ammo.

the fourth horseman.name: The Fourth Horseman
the fourth horseman.description:
Rapid-Fire Arc Pellet Shotgun.
Fires 12 pellets with a 1.1x Precision Multiplier.
Each successive shot within 0.5 seconds has increased damage and pellet spread.
2nd: +17.7% damage and +25% pellet spread.
3rd: +36.5% damage and +33% pellet spread
4th: +56.5% damage and +33% pellet spread
5th: +77.5% damage and +33% pellet spread
Kills refill ammo from reserve.
Catalyst grants unique perk And Its Name Was Death: Passively grants +40 Reload and +1 Magazine size.
This shotgun is absolutely atrocious. Struggles to 1HKO, and follow up shots having increased pellet spread makes it harder to clean up targets even with rapid shots.

ex diris.name: Ex Diris
ex diris.description:
Arc Hive Boomer Grenade Launcher
Weapon does not require reloading ever.
Shoots Arcing Arc projectiles which deal 21 impact damage and up to 119 explosive damage vs. Guardians, down to 35.3 damage at 4.5meters.
Builds up 25% Enrage per hit, gradually granting up to 0.6x Firing Recovery Delay (effectively 40% RPM increase)
Reaching Critical Health immediately grants maximum Enrage. Charge decays over 9.5 seconds.
Upon Final Blow or scoring 2 Direct Hits rapidly, spawns a Loyal Arc Moth which seeks the closest enemy within 60?m, and deals 31 Explosive Arc damage over 7meters, and inflicts Arc Blind,
Moths do not deal self-damage to user. Incurs a 3 second cooldown between Moth spawns.
Catalyst grants unique perk Berserk Rush: Grants Amplified on Kill. Hits while Amplified grant 50% Enrage progress on hit.
While using the Hunter Exotic Mothkeeper's Wraps: Loyal Arc Moth spawns additionally spawn a Loyal Void Moth, which seeks out the nearest Ally and grant them 22.5 Void Overshield on contact.
Weapon is best used as a clean-up tool, and struggles to kill targets even in 2 shots unless you direct impact with both.

heartshadow.name: Heartshadow
heartshadow.description:
Short Range Projectile Sword.
Heavy Attacks while Sword Energy is full fires a fan of up to 4 short range, fast moving Void explosives which deal 363 damage vs. Guardians, and turn the user Invisible for 6.3 seconds.
After being invisible for 0.25s (from any source), gain Shot in the Dark. Shot in the Dark grants 25% increased damage, and hits Weaken enemies for 3 seconds. Kills grant Invisibility for 6.3 seconds.
Catalyst grants unique perk Wraithwalk: Increases reserves by 6, and grants +50% Movement Speed while Shot in the Dark is active.
Generally not a very useful Heavy sword option, especially compared to Eager Edge choices. There are easier ways to achieve Invisibility, and swords that are much faster moving, deadlier, and more ammo efficient.

verglas curve.name: Verglas Curve
verglas curve.description:
Lightweight Combat Bow.
Final Blows grant 1 stack of Hail Barrage, up to a max of 5 stacks. Stacks persist through stow.
Hipfiring will release all Hail Barrage stacks simultaneously in an evenly spaced volley.
Hail Barrage arrows spawn a Large Stasis Crystal on hit/impact, inflicting x60 Slow for 1+1 seconds on Direct Hit.
Deals 50% increased damage to Frozen Enemies & Stasis Crystals.
Catalyst grants Unique Trait Shiver Quiver: Upon inflicting Slow or Freeze, gain 0.65x Draw Time for Verglas Curve for 5 seconds.
Generally just not a good bow. There are easier, more consistent ways to freeze, slow, or shatter targets.

deterministic chaos.name: Deterministic Chaos
deterministic chaos.description:
Very, very bad LMG. Does nothing good and is significantly worse than almost every other LMG in the game despite being an exotic.
Volatile every 4th shot.
Weaken every 16th shot (32nd shot? Seems bugged??)
Catalyst grants Target Lock.

devil's ruin.name: Devil's Ruin
devil's ruin.description:
Adaptive Sidearm.
Hits against Suspended targets inflict x20+10 Scorch.
Final Blows spawn Firesprite. Picking up a Firesprite grants Pyrogenesis Available. Hold special Reload to convert Pyrogenesis Available to Pyrogenesis Ready. Both Pyrogenesis states persists through Stow.
While Pyrogenesis Ready: Firing this weapon instead charges over 0.5seconds then discharges a continuous Solar Beam over 0.95seconds, which deals 22 damage per hit (35.2 Precision) and deals x20+10 Scorch per hit up to 16 times at 900 RPM. Kills with this Laser cause an immediate Ignition at target location. Magazine is refilled upon complete discharge of Pyrogenesis laser.
Catalyst grants this weapon the Collective Action perk.
Weapon can be used to easily convert a single kill into 2.

edge of intent.name: Edge of Intent
edge of intent.description:
Aggressive Glaive.
After scoring 6 hits, either by Glaive Melee or Glaive projectile hits: Enables Special Reload. Glaive Projectiles count as 2 hits.
Special Reload converts the next shot into a placeable Healing turret, refilling & overfilling the magazine by +1, and granting +1 ammo.
Healing Turret lasts 9 seconds and releases a Healing Seeker to the user and nearby allies within 30 meters every 3 seconds if they are not at full HP. Each turret can release up to 3 Seekers over its lifetime.
Healing Seekers grants Cure x1 & Restoration x1 for 3 (+1.5 w/ Ember of Solace) seconds in a 7.5m radius.
Touch of Flame grants the USER ONLY x2 Cure & x2 Restoration.
Catalyst grants Heal Clip perk.

ruinous effigy.name: Ruinous Effigy
ruinous effigy.description:
"COME ON AND SLAM!"
Converts enemies into Transmutation Spheres on Final Blow.
Transmutation Spheres have 30 ammo, and can persist on the ground for 30 seconds.
User can pickup the Spheres, which have a Light Attack, Heavy Attack, and Guard actions.
Light Attack does a small lunge and deals 150 damage vs. Guardians (187.5 while airborne), and consumes 1 ammo per swing. 
Heavy Attack performs a ~5meter area AoE slam, immediately consuming the Sphere and dealing 300 damage & suppressing to all enemies within the radius with NO FALLOFF. 
Guarding generates a Life Drain field in a sphere shaped area around the user, granting 50% Damage Resist, Immunity to Knockback effects, and dealing 12 damage every 0.3 seconds to enemies within the field. Each damage instance to enemies transfers 5/HP to user as well. Ammo is drained at a rate of 1 per every 0.25s. Drains slower when at 3 or lower ammo, at a rate of 1/0.50s. At 1 Ammo, instead triggers TRANSFIGURATION, dealing increasing self damage every 0.7s, until Guard cancel or User Death. Transfiguration ignores all forms of Damage Resist.
Catalyst grants Unique Trait Deconstruction: Transmutation Orb kills grant a flat +15% damage buff for 7 seconds.
This weapon is actually surprisingly dangerous to play against. In Trials, a good player can convert a single Trace Rifle kill into a sphere and easily collapse it onto a 2nd or even 3rd player very rapidly ending the round. Pairs especially well with Cyrtarache's Facade & Grapple, or Blink movement builds.

symmetry.name: Symmetry
symmetry.description:
Arc Rapid-Fire Scout Rifle.
Hold Special Reload to swap to Tracking Arc Seekers mode.
Arc Seekers deal 50 damage per hit to Guardians, in a small AoE splash of ~3m.
Precision Hits & Final Blows grant Dynamic Charge stacks. 
Special Reload refills the magazine equivalent to the number of Dynamic Charge stacks & overcharges Arc Seekers by an escalating amount of +% damage based on the number of Dynamic Charge stacks.
At x3 DC Stacks, becomes 3HKO vs. Guardians, at x7+, becomes 2HKO vs. Guardians.
Hits with Arc Seekers grant +2 Bolt Charge stacks, while at 10 or higher Dynamic Charge stacks, grants +3 Bolt Charge stacks instead.
Arc Seeker damage can discharge Bolt Charge so long as you have at least x1 Dynamic Charge when damage is dealt. Storm's Keep will discharge TWO INSTANCES of Bolt Charge in this scenario.
Catalyst allows Dynamic Charge to stack up to 20x and grants the Eddy Current trait.

the prospector.name: The Prospector
the prospector.description:
Fires Exploding Submunition grenades.
Unlike most Rapid-Fire Heavy GLs, can reliably 1-shot on direct impact due to extra damage dealt by submunitions after target hit so long as the target is actually hit by the submunitions.
Airborne targets are unlikely to get hit, as the submunitions spawn from point of impact and then drop downwards.

vigilance wing.name: Vigilance Wing
vigilance wing.description:
5-Round burst Pulse Rifle. 0.83 base TTK, at 8c2b.
On Ally Death within 24meters: Gain +20 Mobility, increases Sprint Speed to by +0.5m/s (up to 9m/s cap), increases slide distance by +2.0m (Base 6.5->8.5m) for 6 seconds. Immediately triggers Health regeneration.
While Last Guardian Standing or Solo: Grants +100 Health Stat, +?(Significant) Handling, and +30? Reload Speed.
Generally just worse than just about any other standard pulse rifle due to the increased bullet count per burst. Bonuses have reliable uptime in 6s, but due to their triggers being tied nearby & ally deaths, can be somewhat inconsistent for being active when you actually need/want them.

worldline zero.name: Worldline Zero
worldline zero.description:
Basically an easy-mode, less ammo efficient Eager Edge sword.
While at full Sword Energy, enables Tesseract Blink Heavy attack after sprinting briefly. Can be used mid-air.
Tesseract Blink Heavy attack functions similar to a Vortex Frame heavy attack, lunging forward a great distance while spinning and dealing damage in a circle around your character, costs 3 ammo to use.
Scoring a Final Blow with Tesseract Blink attack automatically re-activates Tesseract Blink to be used. Can be used even without full Sword Energy during this time, reducing ammo cost of the heavy attack to 1 instead of 3.
Generally recommend using any Eager Edge sword over this.

still hunt.name: Still Hunt
still hunt.description:
Special Reload while charged to gain 3 Golden Gun shots. Charge granted on 6 crits (2 Points progress per Crit) or by collecting 12 orbs (1 point progress per Orb collected), or by any mixture of Crits/Orbs which = 12 points. Progress persists through death.
Spawns 3 ammo from thin air on Golden Gun cast.
Intrinsically has increased Aim Assist, Faster ADS speed, and Bonus Flinch Resistance. These bonuses are increased when Cayde's Retribution is active. Additionally, Cayde's Retribution also grants 18% increased Aim Assist fall off distance, and -60%? Accuracy Cone buffs.
Golden Gun shots deal 238 base damage with a 2x Precision Multiplier. Successive hits with Golden Gun shots increase subsequent damage, x2 = 45%, x3 = 90%.

revision zero.name: Revision Zero
revision zero.description:
Dealing Precision damage grants Targeting Data progress, up to 4 stacks. Special Reload will convert current Targeting Data into equivalent number of Hunter's Trace rounds. Replaces weapon's base 18 zoom with a 50 zoom Sniper Scope that fires WITH PERFECT ACCURACY & produces Sniper Glint on enemy screen.
Hunter's Trace shots deal massively increased damage, release a small Exhausting Kinetic Shockwave on hit, and overpenetrates targets AND Barricades.
Shots deal 158 base body shot damage, 513.5 Precision damage, and 20 damage from Kinetic Shockwave, Kinetic Shockwave Exhausts targets for 5s, reducing their outgoing damage by 10%.
Can "Grind Stacks" like Hawkmoon or No Time via dealing damage even without landing a Final Blow. Once charged, can be used to break a stalemate or get a pick. Hunter's Trace rounds persist through Stow and are only cleared by firing all loaded rounds or dying.

lumina.name: Lumina
lumina.description:
Final Blows create Remnant at target location, with catalyst this is increased to 2 Remnants. Collect Remnants to receive Noble Rounds equal to number of Remnants gathered.
Noble Rounds hip-fired at Allies immediately heal target for 90HP and grant user & Allied Target +15% Damage buff & +100 Class stat for 11 seconds. Damage buff stacks with other Damage buffs multiplicatively, and is enough to shift TTK on a large variety of weapons on its own. Class stat bonus will activate >100 Overshield effect as well if user has enough Class (1 at least Lol) to reach over 100. 
Boots of the Assembler's Noble Seekers grant user 1 Noble Round per seeker.

sunshot.name: Sunshot
sunshot.description:
150 RPM Hand Cannon, 0.80 TTK.
Intrinsic Explosive Payload.
Scorching explosions on kill, functionally a 2x stronger Firefly w/ a weaker variant of Incandescent DoT attached, which deals 10+5 Scorch creating a brief healing delay.

polaris lance.name: Polaris Lance
polaris lance.description:
Gains Scorching Explosive round on four precision hits. 
Scorch round deals 78 damage in a small radius and applies x40+20 Scorch to targets hit by AoE.
Dragonfly & Zen Moment. 
Energy slot alternative to The Jade Rabbit, with a DoT that can create opportunities to push up on weakened enemies.

red death reformed.name: Red Death Reformed
red death reformed.description:
Uses Auto Rifle recoil pattern and has naturally low Recoil Bounce Intensity.
Improved Heal Clip with +100 Reload & 0.8x Reload Duration boost and Cure x2 on kill, and Cure x1 to Allies within 15?m
Deals up to 6% increased damage as your shield is damaged. Starting at 2%, up to 6% at 0 Shield (Critical Health).
Spawns ToF Healing grenade on every 2nd Final Blow. Incredible for keeping your team healthy.

tarrabah.name: Tarrabah
tarrabah.description:
Base 16 Zoom and low recoil intensity. Ravenous Beast grants significant fire rate increase.
50% Solar resist while Ravenous Beast is active. 
Can "Grind Stacks" similar to Hawkmoon or No Time, simply deal damage and even without securing final blows you will eventually be able to activate Ravenous Beast to break a stalemate or get a pick.

ergo sum.name: Ergo Sum
ergo sum.description:
Special ammo sword with different exotic traits. Spawns with ZERO ammo every life or start of each round in Trials. Receives 50% Ammo progress from Wall Ammo boxes.
Specifically powerful in PvP with the Wave Frame-Arc Conductor variant. 
Increased damage and grenade regen while Transcendent
Regens ammo on Prismatic grenade damage.

turncoat.name: Turncoat
turncoat.description:
Semi-Explosive Payload Void Adaptive 140 Handcannon.
Charges Unleashed Power via Dealing Damage/Final Blows. Can "Grind Stacks" similar to Hawkmoon or No Time by dealing damage even without securing final blows, then once charged can be used to break stalemates or get a pick.
While fully charged Hold Reload to activate Unleashed Power, converting to 225 RPM Last Word frame w/ extreme unlimited ammo, inflicts weaken on hit, damage buffs & explosive payload.

legend of acrius.name: Legend of Acrius
legend of acrius.description:
Fires Shock Blast shells which deal EXTREMELY high damage, overpenetrates targets, and have MASSIVELY increased Range compared to other shotguns.
Gains Trench Barrel via Catalyst.

cloudstrike.name: Cloudstrike
cloudstrike.description:
Lightning storm and Bolt Charge x5 on Precision kill or 3 Rapid Precision Hits
Catalyst grants +25 Handling and Triple Tap

conditional finality.name: Conditional Finality
conditional finality.description:
"Pride Eternal's American Nightmare."
Fires in Stasis Triangle & Solar Circle Patterns.
Freeze or Ignite on 10 pellets hit.
Anti-Cheese/DR & AoE shotgun.
Catalyst provides Rimestealer & Heal Clip perks.
Will kill through Weavewalk, Antaeus, Overshields, etc. & is very strong vs. supers.

outbreak perfected.name: Outbreak Perfected
outbreak perfected.description:
Uses unique low-recoil/bounce intensity Auto Rifle Recoil pattern.
Tracking Nanites spawn on precision hits, and Nanite Swarms spawn on Precision Kills.
Nanites deal 13 per hit, and increase damage taken by further nanites for a short duration.
Prevents enemy res for a brief time via Swarm Clouds.

duality.name: Duality
duality.description:
Dual pellet/slug modes. Fires pellet spread while hip-firing, or fires Slugs while ADS.
Instrinsically has 5% increased range/fall off distance vs. Legendary shotguns.
On Black Wings stacking damage perk.
Catalyst grants: +20 Range & increases magainze size to 8 Baseline.

final warning.name: Final Warning
final warning.description:
While Hip-firing: Fires Unraveling tracking projectile burst on Charge-Shot that deals 20% increased Body shot damage.
While ADS: Fires Hitscan projectiles with 100% crit damage bonus.
Very devestating to play against in good hands.
Charge Time shot is not good against teams who will teamshot you before the charge completes, or void hunters who dodge with Vanishing Step to break Tracking.

graviton spike grenades.name: Graviton Spike Grenades
graviton spike grenades.description:
150 RPM Handcannon, 0.80 TTK.
3 crits or kills overcharge 3 shots of alternate mode. 
Like Hawkmoon or No Time, can "Grind Stacks" to convert to empowered shots to break stalemates or get a pick. Not as effective though as the extra damage isn't as substantial to guarantee a kill, but Stasis Slow and Lightning AoE can punish overextending opponents.
Stasis spawns crystals, Arc has lightning
Temporal Alignment: 20% damage on both overcharges

rat king.name: Rat King
rat king.description:
"Free Kit & a Level 1 Stitcher."
Rat Pack increases fire rate and mag size on reload.
Invisibility and Health regen on kill reload.

winterbite.name: Winterbite
winterbite.description:
Can be used as a standard Glaive even without ammo, granting access to a Close Range combat option at all times.
Fires medium speed Freezing explosive projectiles.
50% melee damage boost while loaded with Ammo, enables 2 hit melee kill.

ace of spades.name: Ace of Spades
ace of spades.description:
"I'm coming home, Ace."
Adaptive 140 Hand Cannon
+27% damage via Memento Mori for 6 shots
Built-in unique, stronger Firefly & Always Active Radar.
Firefly does more damage while Memento Mori is active.

fighting lion.name: Fighting Lion
fighting lion.description:
Gains +70 reload for 7s on damage dealt
Deals +24.5% damage to shields, Volatile on hit
Kills near Fighting Lion damage refill mag

hawkmoon.name: Hawkmoon
hawkmoon.description:
"Lord, I can't change..."
Escalating damage bonus up to 508% damage on final shot of a Magazine, based on stacks of Paracausal Charges gained, up to 7 stacks.
Very strong vs. Supers, DR, etc. Can also "Grind Stacks" via precision hits even without landing Final Blows, then convert to a 1-tap with high stacks to break stalemates or get a pick.
Catalyst increases mag size by 1, and grants Hunter's Trance perk.
Hunter's Trance grants escalating Range, Reload, and Handling per stack of Paracausal Shot.
Grants +8 / +14 / +22 / +26 / +28 / +29 / +30 Range.
+15 / +25 / +35 / +40 / +50 / +50(?) / Reload
+? / +? / +? / +? / +? Handling

no time to explain.name: No Time to Explain
no time to explain.description:
"I don't even have time to explain why I don't have time to explain."
Time-slip Portal fires additional bursts of Pulse Rifle fire automatically at targets. Typically deals body shot damage, but CAN hit precision hits in rare cases. 
Like Hawkmoon and Tarrabah, you can "Grind Stacks" without securing any kills simply by landing precisions even if you do not land Final Blows. This makes this weapon exceptionally powerful to break stalemates.
Enables easier, more consietent two-burst kills when active.

the chaperone.name: The Chaperone
the chaperone.description:
"Model 1887."
Yeehaw Shotgun.
Extra large sized headshot accuracy & AA cone, with 5% extended range vs. other slug shotguns.
Snags headshot in different area codes.
The Roadborn provides precision damage & handling buff

the jade rabbit.name: The Jade Rabbit
the jade rabbit.description:
Oppressive Scout rifle that very easily hits optimal 0.80 TTK, and has built-in Firefly & Shoot to Loot.
Loads Micro-Missile Rocket when special reload is performed w/ Stacks of Fate of All Fools active.
Buffs body damage on precision hits

the last word.name: The Last Word
the last word.description:
"Yours... Not mine."
Yeehaw Hand Cannon. Massively increased Fan Fire hip fire accuracy, precision hits while hip-fired increase damage increase slightly.
225 RPM, 0.53 TTK.

thorn.name: Thorn
thorn.description:
"Every Rose has its..."
Inflicts Poison on hit, inflicting extra damage and preventing health regen.
Spawns Remnant on kill at target location. Collecting Remnants loads/overflows 4 rounds into the magazine, up to 40 total, and grants Soul Devourer & Refined Soul (with Catalyst) for 7 seconds, and can be refreshed up to a maximum of 11 seconds by picking up additional Remnants. Additionally, Refined Soul will trigger on Kill.
Soul Devourer increases Poison damage from 0.4 to 1.6 damage per tick, and Refined Soul grants +10 Range, +15 Handling, and +50 Mobility. Both Soul Devourer & Refined Soul persist through stow.

Exotic Weapons.name: Vex Mythoclast
Exotic Weapons.description: Overcharge linear shots on kill stacks

Exotic Weapons.name: Devil's Ruin
Exotic Weapons.description:
Adaptive Sidearm.
Hits against Suspended targets inflict x20+10 Scorch.
Final Blows spawn Firesprite. Picking up a Firesprite grants Pyrogenesis Available. Hold special Reload to convert Pyrogenesis Available to Pyrogenesis Ready. Both Pyrogenesis states persists through Stow.
While Pyrogenesis Ready: Firing this weapon instead charges over 0.5seconds then discharges a continuous Solar Beam over 0.95seconds, which deals 22 damage per hit (35.2 Precision) and deals x20+10 Scorch per hit up to 16 times at 900 RPM. Kills with this Laser cause an immediate Ignition at target location. Magazine is refilled upon complete discharge of Pyrogenesis laser.
Catalyst grants this weapon the Collective Action perk.
Weapon can be used to easily convert a single kill into 2.

Exotic Weapons.name: Still Hunt
Exotic Weapons.description:
Special Reload while charged to gain 3 Golden Gun shots. Charge granted on 6 crits (2 Points progress per Crit) or by collecting 12 orbs (1 point progress per Orb collected), or by any mixture of Crits/Orbs which = 12 points. Progress persists through death.
Spawns 3 ammo from thin air on Golden Gun cast.
Intrinsically has increased Aim Assist, Faster ADS speed, and Bonus Flinch Resistance. These bonuses are increased when Cayde's Retribution is active. Additionally, Cayde's Retribution also grants 18% increased Aim Assist fall off distance, and -60%? Accuracy Cone buffs.
Golden Gun shots deal 238 base damage with a 2x Precision Multiplier. Successive hits with Golden Gun shots increase subsequent damage, x2 = 45%, x3 = 90%.

Exotic Weapons.name: Revision Zero
Exotic Weapons.description:
Dealing Precision damage grants Targeting Data progress, up to 4 stacks. Special Reload will convert current Targeting Data into equivalent number of Hunter's Trace rounds. Replaces weapon's base 18 zoom with a 50 zoom Sniper Scope that fires WITH PERFECT ACCURACY & produces Sniper Glint on enemy screen.
Hunter's Trace shots deal massively increased damage, release a small Exhausting Kinetic Shockwave on hit, and overpenetrates targets AND Barricades.
Shots deal 158 base body shot damage, 513.5 Precision damage, and 20 damage from Kinetic Shockwave, Kinetic Shockwave Exhausts targets for 5s, reducing their outgoing damage by 10%.
Can "Grind Stacks" like Hawkmoon or No Time via dealing damage even without landing a Final Blow. Once charged, can be used to break a stalemate or get a pick. Hunter's Trace rounds persist through Stow and are only cleared by firing all loaded rounds or dying.

Exotic Weapons.name: Lumina
Exotic Weapons.description:
Final Blows create Remnant at target location, with catalyst this is increased to 2 Remnants. Collect Remnants to receive Noble Rounds equal to number of Remnants gathered.
Noble Rounds hip-fired at Allies immediately heal target for 90HP and grant user & Allied Target +15% Damage buff & +100 Class stat for 11 seconds. Damage buff stacks with other Damage buffs multiplicatively, and is enough to shift TTK on a large variety of weapons on its own. Class stat bonus will activate >100 Overshield effect as well if user has enough Class (1 at least Lol) to reach over 100. 
Boots of the Assembler's Noble Seekers grant user 1 Noble Round per seeker.

Exotic Weapons.name: Sunshot
Exotic Weapons.description:
150 RPM Hand Cannon, 0.80 TTK.
Intrinsic Explosive Payload.
Scorching explosions on kill, functionally a 2x stronger Firefly w/ a weaker variant of Incandescent DoT attached, which deals 10+5 Scorch creating a brief healing delay.

Exotic Weapons.name: Polaris Lance
Exotic Weapons.description:
Gains Scorching Explosive round on four precision hits. 
Scorch round deals 78 damage in a small radius and applies x40+20 Scorch to targets hit by AoE.
Dragonfly & Zen Moment. 
Energy slot alternative to The Jade Rabbit, with a DoT that can create opportunities to push up on weakened enemies.

Exotic Weapons.name: Red Death Reformed
Exotic Weapons.description:
Uses Auto Rifle recoil pattern and has naturally low Recoil Bounce Intensity.
Improved Heal Clip with +100 Reload & 0.8x Reload Duration boost and Cure x2 on kill, and Cure x1 to Allies within 15?m
Deals up to 6% increased damage as your shield is damaged. Starting at 2%, up to 6% at 0 Shield (Critical Health).
Spawns ToF Healing grenade on every 2nd Final Blow. Incredible for keeping your team healthy.

Exotic Weapons.name: Tarrabah
Exotic Weapons.description:
Base 16 Zoom and low recoil intensity. Ravenous Beast grants significant fire rate increase.
50% Solar resist while Ravenous Beast is active. 
Can "Grind Stacks" similar to Hawkmoon or No Time, simply deal damage and even without securing final blows you will eventually be able to activate Ravenous Beast to break a stalemate or get a pick.

Exotic Weapons.name: Ergo Sum
Exotic Weapons.description:
Special ammo sword with different exotic traits. Spawns with ZERO ammo every life or start of each round in Trials. Receives 50% Ammo progress from Wall Ammo boxes.
Specifically powerful in PvP with the Wave Frame-Arc Conductor variant. 
Increased damage and grenade regen while Transcendent
Regens ammo on Prismatic grenade damage.

Exotic Weapons.name: Turncoat
Exotic Weapons.description:
Semi-Explosive Payload Void Adaptive 140 Handcannon.
Charges Unleashed Power via Dealing Damage/Final Blows. Can "Grind Stacks" similar to Hawkmoon or No Time by dealing damage even without securing final blows, then once charged can be used to break stalemates or get a pick.
While fully charged Hold Reload to activate Unleashed Power, converting to 225 RPM Last Word frame w/ extreme unlimited ammo, inflicts weaken on hit, damage buffs & explosive payload.

Exotic Weapons.name: Legend of Acrius
Exotic Weapons.description:
Fires Shock Blast shells which deal EXTREMELY high damage, overpenetrates targets, and have MASSIVELY increased Range compared to other shotguns.
Gains Trench Barrel via Catalyst.

Exotic Weapons.name: Cloudstrike
Exotic Weapons.description:
Lightning storm and Bolt Charge x5 on Precision kill or 3 Rapid Precision Hits
Catalyst grants +25 Handling and Triple Tap

Exotic Weapons.name: Conditional Finality
Exotic Weapons.description:
"Pride Eternal's American Nightmare."
Fires in Stasis Triangle & Solar Circle Patterns.
Freeze or Ignite on 10 pellets hit.
Anti-Cheese/DR & AoE shotgun.
Catalyst provides Rimestealer & Heal Clip perks.
Will kill through Weavewalk, Antaeus, Overshields, etc. & is very strong vs. supers.

Exotic Weapons.name: Outbreak Perfected
Exotic Weapons.description:
Uses unique low-recoil/bounce intensity Auto Rifle Recoil pattern.
Tracking Nanites spawn on precision hits, and Nanite Swarms spawn on Precision Kills.
Nanites deal 13 per hit, and increase damage taken by further nanites for a short duration.
Prevents enemy res for a brief time via Swarm Clouds.

Exotic Weapons.name: Duality
Exotic Weapons.description:
Dual pellet/slug modes. Fires pellet spread while hip-firing, or fires Slugs while ADS.
Instrinsically has 5% increased range/fall off distance vs. Legendary shotguns.
On Black Wings stacking damage perk.
Catalyst grants: +20 Range & increases magainze size to 8 Baseline.

Exotic Weapons.name: Final Warning
Exotic Weapons.description:
While Hip-firing: Fires Unraveling tracking projectile burst on Charge-Shot that deals 20% increased Body shot damage.
While ADS: Fires Hitscan projectiles with 100% crit damage bonus.
Very devestating to play against in good hands.
Charge Time shot is not good against teams who will teamshot you before the charge completes, or void hunters who dodge with Vanishing Step to break Tracking.

Exotic Weapons.name: Graviton Spike Grenades
Exotic Weapons.description:
150 RPM Handcannon, 0.80 TTK.
3 crits or kills overcharge 3 shots of alternate mode. 
Like Hawkmoon or No Time, can "Grind Stacks" to convert to empowered shots to break stalemates or get a pick. Not as effective though as the extra damage isn't as substantial to guarantee a kill, but Stasis Slow and Lightning AoE can punish overextending opponents.
Stasis spawns crystals, Arc has lightning
Temporal Alignment: 20% damage on both overcharges

Exotic Weapons.name: Rat King
Exotic Weapons.description:
"Free Kit & a Level 1 Stitcher."
Rat Pack increases fire rate and mag size on reload.
Invisibility and Health regen on kill reload.

Exotic Weapons.name: Winterbite
Exotic Weapons.description:
Can be used as a standard Glaive even without ammo, granting access to a Close Range combat option at all times.
Fires medium speed Freezing explosive projectiles.
50% melee damage boost while loaded with Ammo, enables 2 hit melee kill.

Exotic Weapons.name: Ace of Spades
Exotic Weapons.description:
"I'm coming home, Ace."
Adaptive 140 Hand Cannon
+27% damage via Memento Mori for 6 shots
Built-in unique, stronger Firefly & Always Active Radar.
Firefly does more damage while Memento Mori is active.

Exotic Weapons.name: Fighting Lion
Exotic Weapons.description:
Gains +70 reload for 7s on damage dealt
Deals +24.5% damage to shields, Volatile on hit
Kills near Fighting Lion damage refill mag

Exotic Weapons.name: Hawkmoon
Exotic Weapons.description:
"Lord, I can't change..."
Escalating damage bonus up to 508% damage on final shot of a Magazine, based on stacks of Paracausal Charges gained, up to 7 stacks.
Very strong vs. Supers, DR, etc. Can also "Grind Stacks" via precision hits even without landing Final Blows, then convert to a 1-tap with high stacks to break stalemates or get a pick.
Catalyst increases mag size by 1, and grants Hunter's Trance perk.
Hunter's Trance grants escalating Range, Reload, and Handling per stack of Paracausal Shot.
Grants +8 / +14 / +22 / +26 / +28 / +29 / +30 Range.
+15 / +25 / +35 / +40 / +50 / +50(?) / Reload
+? / +? / +? / +? / +? Handling

Exotic Weapons.name: No Time to Explain
Exotic Weapons.description:
"I don't even have time to explain why I don't have time to explain."
Time-slip Portal fires additional bursts of Pulse Rifle fire automatically at targets. Typically deals body shot damage, but CAN hit precision hits in rare cases. 
Like Hawkmoon and Tarrabah, you can "Grind Stacks" without securing any kills simply by landing precisions even if you do not land Final Blows. This makes this weapon exceptionally powerful to break stalemates.
Enables easier, more consietent two-burst kills when active.

Exotic Weapons.name: The Chaperone
Exotic Weapons.description:
"Model 1887."
Yeehaw Shotgun.
Extra large sized headshot accuracy & AA cone, with 5% extended range vs. other slug shotguns.
Snags headshot in different area codes.
The Roadborn provides precision damage & handling buff

Exotic Weapons.name: The Jade Rabbit
Exotic Weapons.description:
Oppressive Scout rifle that very easily hits optimal 0.80 TTK, and has built-in Firefly & Shoot to Loot.
Loads Micro-Missile Rocket when special reload is performed w/ Stacks of Fate of All Fools active.
Buffs body damage on precision hits

Exotic Weapons.name: The Last Word

Self-damage does not deal damage to Overshields, instead bypassing it.
Catalyst grants unique perk Heat of the Moment: While Ignition Trigger is Active, weapon Final Blows grant Cure x1, and every 5th shot fired applies x10+10 Scorch.

Exotic Weapons.name: Ruinous Effigy
Exotic Weapons.description:
"COME ON AND SLAM!"
Converts enemies into Transmutation Spheres on Final Blow.
Transmutation Spheres have 30 ammo, and can persist on the ground for 30 seconds.
User can pickup the Spheres, which have a Light Attack, Heavy Attack, and Guard actions.
Light Attack does a small lunge and deals 150 damage vs. Guardians (187.5 while airborne), and consumes 1 ammo per swing. 
Heavy Attack performs a ~5meter area AoE slam, immediately consuming the Sphere and dealing 300 damage & suppressing to all enemies within the radius with NO FALLOFF. 
Guarding generates a Life Drain field in a sphere shaped area around the user, granting 50% Damage Resist, Immunity to Knockback effects, and dealing 12 damage every 0.3 seconds to enemies within the field. Each damage instance to enemies transfers 5/HP to user as well. Ammo is drained at a rate of 1 per every 0.25s. Drains slower when at 3 or lower ammo, at a rate of 1/0.50s. At 1 Ammo, instead triggers TRANSFIGURATION, dealing increasing self damage every 0.7s, until Guard cancel or User Death. Transfiguration ignores all forms of Damage Resist.
Catalyst grants Unique Trait Deconstruction: Transmutation Orb kills grant a flat +15% damage buff for 7 seconds.
This weapon is actually surprisingly dangerous to play against. In Trials, a good player can convert a single Trace Rifle kill into a sphere and easily collapse it onto a 2nd or even 3rd player very rapidly ending the round. Pairs especially well with Cyrtarache's Facade & Grapple, or Blink movement builds.

Hits with Arc Seekers grant +2 Bolt Charge stacks, while at 10 or higher Dynamic Charge stacks, grants +3 Bolt Charge stacks instead.
Arc Seeker damage can discharge Bolt Charge so long as you have at least x1 Dynamic Charge when damage is dealt. Storm's Keep will discharge TWO INSTANCES of Bolt Charge in this scenario.

Exotic Weapons.name: Praxic Blade
Exotic Weapons.description:
Special Ammo Sword with varying Traits & Perks based on customizable pieces.
Loses all Ammo on Death & Respawn. Gains reduced (50% less) ammo gains from all Special Ammo sources, such as a Wall boxes and kills. Ammo bricks picked up grant 1 ammo each.
Light Attacks performs a melee combo with each attack dealing 256 damage vs. Guardians. Using a Heavy Attack after performing 3 Light Attacks performs a Cormarant Combo, dealing 368 damage vs. Guardians, followed by 3 hits of 220 damage vs. Guardians each.
Heavy Attack performs a ranged blade throw, homing in on up to 3 enemies within 50 meters, dealing up to 174 damage vs. Guardians. Damage reduced by 80% on return after 3 hits or target loss. Attacking recall the blade immediately.
Heavy Attacks performed while HOLDING Heavy Attack throw the blade in a Straight Line with no tracking and deals 100% increased damage (348 damage vs. Guardians). Releasing Hold immediately recalls the blade.
Blocking provides ~46% DR in a frontal cone and reflects all impacting projectiles back towards targets near your reticle, dealing 50 damage vs. Guardians.
Airborne light attacks deal ~20%? REDUCED damage, preventing 1HKO neutral.
In lieu of detailing everything this does with various customizable pieces, I instead encourage you to look at Destiny Data Compendium for details.
I recommend using Defensive Form, Refraction Core, and Hyperblade for PvP generally. 
Defensive Form grants the following traits: Blocking an attack within 1 second of beginning Guard grants +20% increased damage for 2 seconds. Blocking multiple attacks within ? seconds grants +1 ammo from thin air, with a 1 second cooldown. 
Refraction Core grants the following trait: On Reflect Bolt hit grants Super-Subclass matching effect. Arc = Grants x1 Bolt Charge, Solar = Inflicts x10+7? Scorch to Target, Void = Inflicts Weaken on Target for ? seconds, Stasis = Inflicts x20 Slow on Target for ? seconds, and Strand = Inflicts Sever for ? seconds.  
Hyperblade Catalyst: Reflecting attacks via Guard grants Amplified for 15 seconds, and grants +100% increased Lunge Distance for the next melee swing. Hyperblade is removed on Stow.
Significantly worse than Ergo Sum options for PvP, but can still be useful for being a 3rd-person Peek tool and 1 hit option.

After being invisible for 0.25s (from any source), gain Shot in the Dark. Shot in the Dark grants 25% increased damage, and hits Weaken enemies for 3 seconds. Kills grant Invisibility for 6.3 seconds.
Catalyst grants unique perk Wraithwalk: Increases reserves by 6, and grants +50% Movement Speed while Shot in the Dark is active.

Hail Barrage arrows spawn a Large Stasis Crystal on hit/impact, inflicting x60 Slow for 1+1 seconds on Direct Hit.
Deals 50% increased damage to Frozen Enemies & Stasis Crystals.
Catalyst grants Unique Trait Shiver Quiver: Upon inflicting Slow or Freeze, gain 0.65x Draw Time for Verglas Curve for 5 seconds.
Generally just not a good bow. There are easier, more consistent ways to freeze, slow, or shatter targets.

Exotic Weapons.description:

After scoring 6 hits, either by Glaive Melee or Glaive projectile hits: Enables Special Reload. Glaive Projectiles count as 2 hits.
Special Reload converts the next shot into a placeable Healing turret, refilling & overfilling the magazine by +1, and granting +1 ammo.
Healing Turret lasts 9 seconds and releases a Healing Seeker to the user and nearby allies within 30 meters every 3 seconds if they are not at full HP. Each turret can release up to 3 Seekers over its lifetime.
Healing Seekers grants Cure x1 & Restoration x1 for 3 (+1.5 w/ Ember of Solace) seconds in a 7.5m radius.
Touch of Flame grants the USER ONLY x2 Cure & x2 Restoration.
Catalyst grants Heal Clip perk.

Exotic Weapons.name: Cull's Shadow
Exotic Weapons.description:
Hybrid Aggressive Fusion Rifle / Glaive.
