Scoring 2 rapid hits with Frontal Blades or Scoring a Final Blow grants a stack of Soulfire Charge & heals +40 HP.
Soulfire Charge can be consumed by firing Fusion Rifle bolts, inflicting Potent Corruption poison, dealing ? Damage-over-Time on hit.
Enemies who die under the effect of Potent Corruption are turned into Soulfire Crystals, which can be destroyed to trigger a ? Kinetic Damage detonation over 8 meters.
Soulfire crystals spawn & explode based on varying activation conditions, but can be detonated by dealing damage to them, or expiring after 15 seconds.
This weapon is not good. It also does NOT count as a Glaive Melee for purposes of damage increases. Do not use it in PvP.

Exotic Weapons.name: Fafnir
Exotic Weapons.description:
Precision Linear Fusion Rifle.
Long range Tractor Cannon option.
Converts ammo into an "Overpressurized" shot, which applies a 30% weaken to hit enemies.
As it stands, it isn't worth using this as it eats ammo and doesn't really gain much from doing so. A standard Precision Linear will 1-shot headshot anyone to begin with, even in Supers. The only use case for this is to overpressurize the shot and then body shot 1 target with it.

Exotic Weapons.name: Wolfsbane
Exotic Weapons.description:
Solar Heavy Axe.
Uses the same animation & moveset as Twilight Arsenal's Axes.
Light Attacks deal 377 damage vs. Guardians and spawn 3 Quicksilver Nanites every 3 hits, or on Final Blows.
Heavy Attacks while having at least 10% Sword Energy, consume 3 ammo to generate a Solar Wave similar to Burning Maul, which travel 10 meters forward and deals 301 damage vs. Guardians impacted.
Airborne Heavy attacks ALWAYS consume 2 ammo and generate Solar Wave, regardless of Sword Energy.
Wolfsbane deals up to 25% increased damage to targets affected by Outbreak Perfected's Nanites.
Quicksilver Nanites attach to user and restore +5? HP on pickup, granting progress towards Nano-Assault & Overclock. Progress resets on Death.
Overclock can be activated once progress has reached full. Activate via Special Reload. Once activated, gain +14 Ammo from thin air, +25% damage, and rapidly gain +30% Sword Energy per second.
While Overclocked, Heavy Attacks always generate Solar Wave. Fully Charged Heavy Attacks generate a Quicksilver Nanite Tornado, dealing 376 damage vs. Guardians, and 55 damage vs Guardians every 0.3 seconds over 5 meters for 3 seconds.
Grants varying amounts of Damage Resistance for 5 seconds upon scoring ? Light Attacks within 3? seconds of each other.
Damage Resistance amount and Hit Requirement change depending on equipped Handle.
Unyielding = 15% DR after 2 hits, Rampager's = 20% DR after 3 hits, and Tenacious = 25% DR after 4 hits.
Has selectable Catalyst which grants various perks. Options are: Burning Ambition, Attrition Orbs, Relentless Strikes, or SUBROUTINE: ~RECURSION.
Recursion: Nanites restore additional HP on pickup based current stacks of Nano-Assault. Spawns additional Nanites while YOU take damage while Nano-Assault is active, with a 2s cooldown.
Generally not a very good Sword option. Caster/Wave Frames can cover the ranged attacks distances easier, and Eager Edge Swords are generally more ammo efficient & useful. Do not use this.

Exotic Weapons.name: Buried Bloodline
Exotic Weapons.description:
Micro-Missile-esque Special Ammo Sidearm.
Fires two Tracking Void Bolts which deal 42.3 (50.76 Precision) damage each.
Each bolt heals 11 HP on hit, for a total of 22 HP possible per shot.
Kills progress a counter towards triggering Devour. Guardians grant 25% per kill. Kills while Devour is active do not grant progress.
Catalyst grants unique perk Splitvein Lineage: While Devour is active, hits Weaken targets for 3? seconds and Grants increased +? Reload and +0.x? Reload Duration.
Has generally the same issues as all the Micro-missile Sidearms in PvP. Does not deal enough damage or consistently hit targets enough, despite additional tracking.

Exotic Weapons.name: Salvation's Grip
Exotic Weapons.description:
Chargeable Stasis Crystal Launcher.
Charged shots fire Stasis crystal projectiles in V shaped pattern.
Uncharged shots behave as impact grenades, and will always detonate impacted Stasis Crystals.
Not very useful as an actual damage dealing weapon, but can be useful as an area denial tool.
Crystals can block hallways, resses, capture points, or sight lines and are durable against enemy damage.
Overall, not particularly useful as there are simply easier, more consistent ways to generate Stasis Crystals if needed that aren't dependent on Heavy ammo.

Exotic Weapons.name: The Fourth Horseman
Exotic Weapons.description:
Rapid-Fire Arc Pellet Shotgun.
Fires 12 pellets with a 1.1x Precision Multiplier.
Each successive shot within 0.5 seconds has increased damage and pellet spread.
2nd: +17.7% damage and +25% pellet spread.
3rd: +36.5% damage and +33% pellet spread
4th: +56.5% damage and +33% pellet spread
5th: +77.5% damage and +33% pellet spread
Kills refill ammo from reserve.
Catalyst grants unique perk And Its Name Was Death: Passively grants +40 Reload and +1 Magazine size.
This shotgun is absolutely atrocious. Struggles to 1HKO, and follow up shots having increased pellet spread makes it harder to clean up targets even with rapid shots.

Exotic Weapons.name: Ex Diris
Exotic Weapons.description:
Arc Hive Boomer Grenade Launcher
Weapon does not require reloading ever.
Shoots Arcing Arc projectiles which deal 21 impact damage and up to 119 explosive damage vs. Guardians, down to 35.3 damage at 4.5meters.
Builds up 25% Enrage per hit, gradually granting up to 0.6x Firing Recovery Delay (effectively 40% RPM increase)
Reaching Critical Health immediately grants maximum Enrage. Charge decays over 9.5 seconds.
Upon Final Blow or scoring 2 Direct Hits rapidly, spawns a Loyal Arc Moth which seeks the closest enemy within 60?m, and deals 31 Explosive Arc damage over 7meters, and inflicts Arc Blind,
Moths do not deal self-damage to user. Incurs a 3 second cooldown between Moth spawns.
Catalyst grants unique perk Berserk Rush: Grants Amplified on Kill. Hits while Amplified grant 50% Enrage progress on hit.
While using the Hunter Exotic Mothkeeper's Wraps: Loyal Arc Moth spawns additionally spawn a Loyal Void Moth, which seeks out the nearest Ally and grant them 22.5 Void Overshield on contact.
Weapon is best used as a clean-up tool, and struggles to kill targets even in 2 shots unless you direct impact with both.

Exotic Weapons.name: Deterministic Chaos
Exotic Weapons.description:
Very, very bad LMG. Does nothing good and is significantly worse than almost every other LMG in the game despite being an exotic.
Volatile every 4th shot.
Weaken every 16th shot (32nd shot? Seems bugged??)
Catalyst grants Target Lock.

Exotic Weapons.name: Vigilance Wing
Exotic Weapons.description:
5-Round burst Pulse Rifle. 0.83 base TTK, at 8c2b.
On Ally Death within 24meters: Gain +20 Mobility, increases Sprint Speed to by +0.5m/s (up to 9m/s cap), increases slide distance by +2.0m (Base 6.5->8.5m) for 6 seconds. Immediately triggers Health regeneration.
While Last Guardian Standing or Solo: Grants +100 Health Stat, +?(Significant) Handling, and +30? Reload Speed.
Generally just worse than just about any other standard pulse rifle due to the increased bullet count per burst. Bonuses have reliable uptime in 6s, but due to their triggers being tied nearby & ally deaths, can be somewhat inconsistent for being active when you actually need/want them.

Exotic Weapons.name: Worldline Zero
Exotic Weapons.description:
Basically an easy-mode, less ammo efficient Eager Edge sword.
While at full Sword Energy, enables Tesseract Blink Heavy attack after sprinting briefly. Can be used mid-air.
Tesseract Blink Heavy attack functions similar to a Vortex Frame heavy attack, lunging forward a great distance while spinning and dealing damage in a circle around your character, costs 3 ammo to use.
Scoring a Final Blow with Tesseract Blink attack automatically re-activates Tesseract Blink to be used. Can be used even without full Sword Energy during this time, reducing ammo cost of the heavy attack to 1 instead of 3.
Generally recommend using any Eager Edge sword over this.
